I Remark. The question whether there exists protocols with exponential positive cut-offs remains open. The family of filter protocols described at Section 3.1 is an example of protocols with a linear positive cut-off. 5.2 Upper bounds on tight cut-offs The results (and proofs) of Section 4 can be used to derive upper bounds on tight cut-offs. We make this explicit in the following theorem. I Theorem 19. For a protocol P = hQ, D, q0 , T i equipped with an initial register value d0 ∈ D and a target location qf ∈ Q, the tight cut-off is at most doubly-exponential in |P|.
